choice: A point before the start must give >= 0 and about 0; a point 500 m past the end must give lineLengthM within 1% (so extrapolation, 10% over, fails, but approximation noise passes)
text: How do the tests check positionAlongM's documented range (between 0 and lineLengthM)?
why: A strict <= lineLengthM check would fail an implementation whose along-distance uses a slightly different segment length than haversine, which the 1% accuracy target allows
